description: The Paris HT 20 has a light alloy frame with 20" alloy wheels. With 6 Shimano gears this is a great junior bike, and with suspension forks upfront it's ideal for all terrains and maximum fun! We take care to design a frame that gives good stand over clearance. This can safeguard kids during the formative years when gaining confidence on the bike is important. Approximate age range 6-8 years. The 2024 Dawes 20" Paris HT is a versatile junior mountain bike, built for aspiring adventurers. Designed for children aged 6 years and up, this bike blends durable, lightweight construction with quality components and features a slightly dropped top tube design for easier mounting and dismounting. Finished in a bright Pink, it is an excellent first bike for tackling the local park, cycling paths, and forest trails Key Features •Lightweight Alloy Chassis: The bike is built around a Dawes Alloy 6061 Junior Frame. This choice of material helps keep the overall weight down, ensuring the bike is manageable and easier for younger riders to handle and pedal over longer distances. •Front Suspension: The inclusion of a Zoom Suspension Fork helps dampen shocks from uneven surfaces, improving comfort and control for the rider on varied ground. •Shimano Drivetrain: A 6-Speed Shimano gear system provides the necessary range for climbs and flats. It uses an easy-to-operate Shimano Revo shifter, which is simple and intuitive for smaller hands to manage. •Built Tough: The 20x125” Tyres are mounted on durable Alloy Rims, offering excellent grip and resilience. With a sturdy build and quality components like the Cartridge Bottom Bracket and Dawes Junior Saddle, the Bullet HT is designed for durability. •Braking: Features practical Alloy V-Brakes with Junior Reach Alloy levers, offering dependable and easy-to-maintain stopping power for young riders. Sizing Guidance Suitable for junior riders aged 6 years and up (20" wheel, 11" frame), typically fitting heights between 3'9" and 4'5" (114 cm to 135 cm).
